verses.1: The songs of those who trust in Jehovah, like Mount Zion, will never be destroyed forever.
verses.2: Jerusalem is surrounded by mountains, and Jehovah is also surrounded by His people, from this day forward and forever.
verses.3: For the wicked will not rest upon the righteous, so that the righteous may not be thrown into the abyss by their own hands.
verses.4: The LORD is good to the good and righteous in their hearts.
verses.5: And those who are bent over will be cast down by Jehovah’s hands. He will bring upon Israel the work of destruction.
